root_cause: V3 mutated the original rigged MPFB body object by replacing its mesh and neutralizing parent/object transforms. On the retained MPFB bind/parent stack, this object-state mutation was not world-geometry invariant even though the copied vertices had been transformed by the evaluated object matrix.
closed_method: replace G3V_BODY data with evaluated mesh and neutralize that same object's rig/parent transform state for depth rendering
next_revision: V4 uses a separate detached object created from the evaluated posed mesh with the exact evaluated matrix_world; G3V_BODY is not mutated.
architecture_impact: none; hidden-3D full-pose guide architecture remains active
